d.title: Edogawa Conan Shissou Jiken: Shijou Saiaku no Futsukakan
d.en: The Disappearance of Conan Edogawa: The Worst Two Days in History
d.jp: 名探偵コナン 江戸川コナン失踪事件～史上最悪の二日間～
d.synopsis: The anime special celebrates the 20th anniversary of Gosho Aoyama's original manga, and it recounts a previously untold story from Conan's past.
